fields.label: Connection Preference
fields.help: The connection preference to use for this service attachment.

fields.label: Consumer Reject Lists
fields.help: An array of projects that are not allowed to connect to this service attachment.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: Domain Names
fields.help: If specified, the domain name will be used during the integration between the PSC connected endpoints and the Cloud DNS.

fields.label: Enable Proxy Protocol
fields.help: If true, enable the proxy protocol which is for supplying client TCP/IP address data in TCP connections that traverse proxies on their way to destination servers.

fields.label: NAT Subnets
fields.help: An array of subnets that is provided for NAT in this service attachment.

fields.label: Propagated Connection Limit
fields.help: The number of consumer spokes that connected Private Service Connect endpoints can be propagated to through Network Connectivity Center.

fields.label: Reconcile Connections
fields.help: This flag determines whether a consumer accept/reject list change can reconcile the statuses of existing ACCEPTED or REJECTED PSC endpoints.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: URL of the region where the resource resides.
